nodes.title: Deployment & Infrastructure
nodes.content:
# Cyberlearn Deployment Structure

**Project Files:**
- Main config: `manage.py`
- Requirements: `requirements.txt` (implied)
- Database: `db.sqlite3` (dev)
- Static files: `staticfiles/`
- Environment: `.env` files

**Environments:**
- Development: `env/local.env`
- Staging/LAN: `env/lan.env`
- Production: `env/prod.env`

nodes.title: Development
nodes.content:
## Local Development Setup

**Database:**
- Type: SQLite
- File: `db.sqlite3`
- Location: Project root
- Data persisted locally

**Backend:**
- Server: `python manage.py runserver`
- Port: 8000 (default)
- Debug: True
- Allowed: localhost:3000

**Frontend:**
- Server: React dev server
- Port: 3000 (default)
- Hot reload enabled
- Proxy to backend

**CORS:**
- Frontend: http://localhost:3000
- Backend: http://localhost:8000

nodes.title: Staging (LAN)
nodes.content:
## Staging Environment

**File:** `env/lan.env`

**Configuration:**
- Network: Local Area Network
- Database: PostgreSQL (likely)
- Debug: False
- Allowed hosts: LAN IPs
- Static files: Collected
- Media: Server path

**Purpose:**
- Test before production
- Internal team testing
- Performance testing
- Bug identification

nodes.title: Production
nodes.content:
## Production Deployment

**File:** `env/prod.env`

**Configuration:**
- Database: PostgreSQL/MySQL
- Server: Gunicorn/uWSGI
- Reverse Proxy: Nginx
- Debug: False
- Allowed hosts: production domain
- SSL/TLS: Enabled
- Static files: CDN or server
- Logging: File/Syslog
- Security:
  - SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT
  - SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE
  - CSRF_COOKIE_SECURE

nodes.title: Static Files
nodes.content:
## Static Files Management

**Directory:** `staticfiles/`

**Contents:**
```
staticfiles/
├── admin/        (Django admin UI)
├── css/          (React build CSS)
├── js/           (React build JS)
├── rest_framework/
└── media/        (User uploads)
    ├── lessons/
    └── videos/
```

**Management:**
- `python manage.py collectstatic`
- Collects from all apps
- Versioning for caching
- CDN deployment (optional)

nodes.title: Database Layer
nodes.content:
## Database Configuration

**Development:**
- Engine: sqlite3
- File: db.sqlite3
- Migrations: `migrations/`

**Production:**
- Engine: PostgreSQL/MySQL
- Hosted: Managed DB service
- Backups: Automated
- Replication: Optional

**Migrations:**
- File location: `learning/migrations/`
- Run: `python manage.py migrate`
- New: `makemigrations`
- History tracked in files

nodes.title: Docker (Optional)
nodes.content:
## Containerization

**Benefits:**
- Consistent environments
- Easy deployment
- Version control
- Scaling

**Typical Setup:**
```dockerfile
FROM python:3.9
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
EXPOSE 8000
CMD ["gunicorn", "..."]
```

**Compose (Optional):**
- Django backend service
- PostgreSQL service
- Nginx service
- Redis cache (optional)

nodes.title: Security Considerations
nodes.content:
## Security Checklist

**Environment:**
- SECRET_KEY in .env ✓
- DEBUG = False (prod)
- ALLOWED_HOSTS configured

**Authentication:**
- HttpOnly cookies ✓
- CSRF protection ✓
- JWT tokens (short-lived)
- Refresh token rotation

**Transport:**
- HTTPS/SSL (prod)
- Secure cookies
- SameSite policy

**Database:**
- SQL injection prevention (ORM)
- Password hashing
- Backups encrypted

**API:**
- Rate limiting
- Input validation
- CORS properly configured
